# KhelGrid · India's Sports Opportunity Network
> KhelGrid is India's verified sports selection trials directory, Khelo India accredited academy network, and sports quota discovery platform.

KhelGrid connects grassroots Indian athletes across 28 sports disciplines with authentic selection combines, Sports Authority of India (SAI) National Centres of Excellence (NCOE), accredited sports academies, and public sector sports quota recruitments.

## Documentation, APIs & Project Overview
- [Documentation & Athlete Guides](https://www.khelgrid.com/guides): Comprehensive athlete development guides, trial preparation roadmaps, and sports quota rules.
- [Sports Data & Trials API](https://www.khelgrid.com/api/trials): Structured REST API endpoint delivering verified national sports selection trials and combine feeds.
- [About KhelGrid](https://www.khelgrid.com/about): Mission, governance, institutional verification standards, and brand entity profile.
- [Trust Center & Verification Policy](https://www.khelgrid.com/trust-center): Rigorous verification methodology ensuring authentic, zero fake trials across all states.
- [Athlete Sports CV Documentation](https://www.khelgrid.com/start-from-zero): Comprehensive guide to building standardized digital athletic resumes for scouting.
- [Editorial & Corrections Policy](https://www.khelgrid.com/editorial-policy): Editorial review standards, gazette cross-referencing, and factual correction protocol.
- [Terms of Service](https://www.khelgrid.com/terms): Official platform terms, athlete code of conduct, and participation guidelines.

## Core Opportunities & Selection Trials
- [Search Sports Selection Trials](https://www.khelgrid.com/search): Real-time searchable directory of verified sports selection trials across India.
- [Verified Opportunities & Selections](https://www.khelgrid.com/opportunities): Detailed selection trials with eligibility criteria, age cutoffs, and entry requirements.
- [Khelo India & SAI Academies](https://www.khelgrid.com/academy): Comprehensive directory of Khelo India and Sports Authority of India accredited training centres.
- [Sports Events & Tournaments](https://www.khelgrid.com/events): Regional championships, national meets, and sports quota notifications.
- [Live Match Center & Scores](https://www.khelgrid.com/live-scores): Real-time scores, cricket commentary, and live tournament tracking.
- [Verified Sports Coaches Directory](https://www.khelgrid.com/coaches): Qualified coaches across multiple sports disciplines in India.

## Venues, Matchmaking & Athlete Tools
- [Book Sports Venues & Turfs](https://www.khelgrid.com/book): Turf booking, badminton courts, and cricket nets across Indian metro cities.
- [Amateur Pickup Games](https://www.khelgrid.com/play): Community sports matchmaking and amateur friendly matches.
- [Sports Training Programs](https://www.khelgrid.com/train): Specialized coaching camps and athletic training clinics.
- [Athletic Calculators & Tools](https://www.khelgrid.com/tools): Athletic performance, calorie, and fitness assessment calculators.
- [Sports Calendar](https://www.khelgrid.com/calendar): Consolidated calendar of national sports trials, tournaments, and combine dates.

## Discipline Selection Trials
- [Cricket Trials Near Me](https://www.khelgrid.com/sport/cricket): U-14 to Senior BCCI and State association selection trials.
- [Football Trials Near Me](https://www.khelgrid.com/sport/football): ISL combines, I-League youth academies, and Santosh Trophy selections.
- [Badminton Trials Near Me](https://www.khelgrid.com/sport/badminton): BAI ranking and state camp selection trials.
- [Athletics Trials Near Me](https://www.khelgrid.com/sport/athletics): Track and field state and national selection combines.
- [Kabaddi Trials Near Me](https://www.khelgrid.com/sport/kabaddi): Junior and senior national kabaddi selection trials.
- [Wrestling Trials Near Me](https://www.khelgrid.com/sport/wrestling): Akhada selection, dangals, and SAI cadet combines.
- [Swimming Trials Near Me](https://www.khelgrid.com/sport/swimming): Aquatics national trials and state junior combines.
- [Shooting Trials Near Me](https://www.khelgrid.com/sport/shooting): NRAI national selection trials and Khelo India combines.
- [Basketball Trials Near Me](https://www.khelgrid.com/sport/basketball): BFI state trials and youth championships.
- [Boxing Trials Near Me](https://www.khelgrid.com/sport/boxing): Cadet and junior national boxing selection trials.

## Metro City Sports Hubs
- [Delhi NCR Sports & Trials](https://www.khelgrid.com/city/delhi): Selection trials, turfs, and academies in Delhi, Noida, and Gurugram.
- [Mumbai Sports & Trials](https://www.khelgrid.com/city/mumbai): Selection trials, turfs, and clubs in Mumbai and Navi Mumbai.
- [Bengaluru Sports & Trials](https://www.khelgrid.com/city/bengaluru): Selection trials, badminton courts, and turfs in Bengaluru.
- [Hyderabad Sports & Trials](https://www.khelgrid.com/city/hyderabad): Selection trials, tennis courts, and academies in Hyderabad.
- [Chandigarh Sports & Trials](https://www.khelgrid.com/city/chandigarh): Selection trials and centres in Punjab and Haryana.
- [Pune Sports & Trials](https://www.khelgrid.com/city/pune): Sports selection combines and venue bookings in Pune.
- [Kolkata Sports & Trials](https://www.khelgrid.com/city/kolkata): Football, cricket, and multisport trials in Kolkata.
- [Chennai Sports & Trials](https://www.khelgrid.com/city/chennai): Selection trials and accredited training academies in Chennai.
